title: The Sword in His Hand
description: An eyewitness welcomes Weed—and remembers the moment the queen thought an old promise had been forgotten.

Hyun.name: 李贤 · Lee Hyun
Hyun.provenance: Approved Hyun B and expression refinement, imagegen concept references 2026-10-14. Translated by hand into articulated SVG: angular cheeks, layered hair, family warmth and eager reward expressions. Original fictional interpretation, not official art.

Attendant.name: 侍女 · Former attendant
Attendant.provenance: Original fictional retired attendant of Queen Evane. Silver bob, angular elder face and muted blue robe, built with shared polished SVG geometry; not official artwork.

sources: Personal Mandarin adaptation of the pinned Chapter 3 passage in The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor; retired attendant visit through the queen’s first disappointment, before the assassination account.

不是不信。是一直太相信，才这么伤心。.english: It was not a lack of trust. She had trusted him so deeply that it hurt this much.

interlinear.gloss: It was not a lack of trust.
She had trusted him so deeply
interlinear.pinyin: shì yì zhí tài xiāng xìn ，

我原来只想问他带来了什么。现在先不问了。.english: I only meant to ask what he had brought. Now I hold that question back.

tā dài lái le shén me 。
